regions.text: those plans. Today is a day for mourning and
regions.explanation: From 10.38s to 12.20s (“those plans. Today is a day for mourning and”), articulation rate was 7.43 syll/s against 5.12 syll/s in the reference (+45%); that is 1.7× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. Faster articulation compresses the stressed syllables and the micro-pauses listeners use to segment phrases, so key words lose emphasis and comprehension drops. Fix: Slow to the reference pace here and let the pauses between clauses breathe.
